insight.headNone: Your insights start with your first workout
insight.headSome: On track, {left} more to go this week
insight.headFresh: A fresh week, start with your next session
insight.tipConsistent: Consistency is your superpower. Keep protecting your rest days.
insight.tipVolumeDown: Volume dipped compared with last week. Normal after a lighter week, so build back gradually.
insight.tipStreak: {n} planned sessions in a row. Rest days never break it.
insight.tipDefault: Small, steady sessions beat rare heroic ones. Aim for your next planned day.

progress.goalReached: You are at your goal weight.
progress.toLose: to lose to reach your goal
progress.toGain: to gain to reach your goal
progress.title: Progress
progress.subtitle: Your training, in numbers
progress.demoNote: Includes 5 weeks of sample history. Remove it anytime in Settings.
progress.consistencyBody: Planned sessions completed over the last 4 weeks. Recovery skips don't count against you.
progress.summaryNone: Finish your first workout and your personal summary shows up here.
progress.summary: You've done {done} of {planned} planned sessions this week with {score}% consistency over four weeks. Your training volume is {trend} compared with last week.
progress.shareText: This week: {done}/{planned} sessions, {streak}-session streak, level {level} in Personal Coach.
progress.shareAwards: Level {level}, {xp} XP and {badges} badges in Personal Coach.

calendar.title: Training calendar
calendar.openAria: Training calendar, open the full calendar
calendar.swipeHint: Swipe or use the arrows to change month
calendar.weekAria: Week of {date}: {status}. Show how it counted
calendar.legendNote: The last column is the week: credited towards the streak, paused, or the current week.

day.notQuality: Under 70% of planned sets, so it doesn't count towards consistency
day.missed: This planned workout wasn't done. One missed day is fine; the next one is what counts.
day.paused: This day is in a pause. It doesn't affect your streak or consistency.

reason.nearest-done: Your nearest workout ({date}) was done, so this rest day counts.
reason.nearest-not-done: Your nearest workout ({date}) wasn't done, so this rest day doesn't count.
reason.nearest-upcoming: It will count once your nearest workout ({date}) is done.
reason.no-training: No workouts were planned this week.
reason.future: Rest days count when the nearest workout is done.

week.title: Week of {date}
week.formula: ({quality} quality workouts + {rest} credited rest days) ÷ {planned} planned days
week.credited: Goal reached: the week counts towards your streak.
week.notCredited: Goal not reached: the week doesn't count towards the streak.
week.current: This week is still in progress. It joins your consistency score once it ends.
week.paused: This week is paused: it's skipped for both streak and consistency.
week.notCounted: Not one of the 4 weeks in your current consistency score.

streak.title: Streak
streak.body: A week counts when you reach your weekly goal. A paused week doesn't break the streak.
streak.empty: Your first workout starts your streak.

built.title: How {score} was built
built.body: Week weights: 40%, 30%, 20% and 10%, newest first. Paused weeks are skipped. We count quality workouts and rest days next to a done workout, divided by planned days.
built.empty: Your score appears after your first full week with a plan.

pause.title: Sick or on holiday?
pause.body: Pause your streak for up to 4 weeks. Consistency skips these weeks too.
pause.activeBody: Your streak is safe. Come back whenever you're ready.
pause.removeBody: The weeks from {from} to {to} will count again for your streak and consistency.

progress.weightNeedMore: Log your weight at least twice to see a trend.
progress.insightsLockedBody: Strength progression per exercise and muscle-group balance, built from your own history.
progress.historyEmptyBody: Your completed sessions will appear here.
progress.recordsEmptyBody: Beat your best weight or reps and it lands here.
progress.photosNote: Photos are stored only in this browser and never uploaded.
progress.photosEmptyBody: Add one every few weeks to see change you can't feel day to day.
progress.removeBody: This photo will be deleted from this device.
progress.photosLockedBody: Free includes {n} photos. Premium keeps your whole journey.

report.nextEmpty: No plan for next week yet.

exercise.title: Your progress
